method: Direct visual inspection of six side-by-side three-stage chains at 256px and separately rasterized 96px in qa-art-c-board.png

I113.props: wooden prayer beads all three ages
I113.identity: round full face, widely spaced eyes, wide short nose and chin preserved
I113.age: old grey thinning ring and facial folds clear; young to mature subtle at 96px

I114.props: empty hands; rope cincture part of habit
I114.identity: long narrow face, prominent ears and long drooping nose preserved
I114.age: mature lines subtle at 96px; elderly thin grey hair and sunken face clearly older

I115.fur: grey-white mottled squirrel miniver, no black tail tips
I115.headwear: below-ear black bob aging to grey
I115.identity: broad jaw and bulb-ended nose preserved
I115.age: progressive greying, eye bags, wrinkles readable

I116.props: folded indigo cloth sample all three
I116.fur: grey-white mottled squirrel miniver, no black tail tips
I116.headwear: below-ear red-brown bob aging to grey
I116.identity: broad high oval and wide chin preserved
I116.age: young to mature subtle; old grey hair and facial sag distinct

I117.props: closed carved wooden casket all three
I117.headwear: blue tied scarf / white linen coif / blue wool hood
I117.identity: narrow diamond face and high cheekbones preserved
I117.age: old revision 2 strengthened wrinkles and neck aging; same identity readable at 256 and 96

I118.props: empty hands below frame all three
I118.headwear: uncovered ribbon / uncovered ribbon / ochre tied scarf
I118.identity: frontal long tapered jaw and broad straight nose preserved
I118.age: old revision 2 strengthened eyelid, jowl and neck aging; same identity readable at 256 and 96

limitations: Numerical ages are narrative metadata, not measurable exact ages.
Young-to-mature changes are intentionally moderate and less obvious at 96px, particularly I114 and I116.
Small seals and miniver texture resolve better at 256px; 96px supports broad clothing and identity reads.
